staffPreheader: Isikhumbuzo esivela ku-{company} malunga noxwebhu lwakho.
staffIntro: I-{company} ilandelela uxwebhu lwakho nge-Vaultara. Olu lufuna ingqalelo yakho kungekudala:
staffAction: Nceda uvuselele ngexesha uze unike i-{company} ikopi yoxwebhu olutsha.
staffContact: Imibuzo? Phendula le imeyile ukuze unxibelelane ne-{company}.
staffFooterWhy: Ufumana le imeyile kuba i-{company} yongeze idilesi yakho ye-imeyile kwizikhumbuzo zoxwebhu.
staffConfirmBody: Awusayi kuphinda ufumane ii-imeyile zezikhumbuzo zoxwebhu ezivela ku-{company}.
staffUnsubscribedBody: Awusayi kuphinda ufumane izikhumbuzo zoxwebhu ezivela ku-{company}. Nxibelelana nabo ukuba utshintsha ingqondo.
invalidLinkBody: Ikhonkco linokuba lidala okanye alipheleli. Nxibelelana neshishini elilithumeleyo.
reportPreheader: Ngubani osemgangathweni, yintoni ephelelwa kwiintsuku ezingama-30 ezizayo, nento ephelelwe.
reportIntro: Nantsi imeko yoxwebhu lweqela lakho namhlanje. Uluhlu olupheleleyo luncanyathelisiwe njengefayile yesipreyitshithi (CSV).
reportNothing: Akukho iirekhodi zokunika ingxelo okwangoku. Yongeza iqela lakho noxwebhu lwalo kwiVaultara.
reportFooterWhy: Ufumana le imeyile kuba usebenzisa iplani ye-Vaultara Business. Unokuyivala kwiVaultara kwisikrini sikaSapho.
reportConfirmBody: Awusayi kuphinda ufumane ingxelo yokuthobela imigaqo nge-imeyile.
reportUnsubscribedBody: Awusayi kuphinda ufumane ingxelo yokuthobela imigaqo. Ungayivula kwakhona kwiVaultara kwisikrini sikaSapho.
requestPreheader: I-{company} icela umhla omtsha wokuphelelwa nefoto yoxwebhu lwakho olwavuselelwa.
requestIntro: I-{company} ikucela ukuba uthumele umhla omtsha wokuphelelwa nefoto okanye i-PDF yolu xwebhu luvuselelweyo:
requestValidity: Eli khonkco lisebenza iintsuku ezi-7 kwaye lingasetyenziswa kube kanye kuphela.
requestFooterWhy: Ufumana le imeyile kuba i-{company} icele uhlaziyo loxwebhu abalandelela ngenxa yakho. Ukuba ubungayilindelanga, ungayiyeka le imeyile.
